author: Hola
body:
I'm LFT. I'd say that I'm decent at pvp and good at communication. I come from OCN and have tourney experience from tourneys 5-8 and a few unofficial ones. I mostly fuck around when I play anything other than competitive matches so please try me out before saying no. 
I can play any position but I'm strongest at midlining/support. I'm also pretty proficient at cannons.
